inputs.52.text: Soft painterly picture-book illustration in thick, velvety gouache: visible round brush strokes, colours laid in soft overlapping layers, edges melting gently into one another, a faint warm paper grain under the paint. A large whale folded from cream paper like origami, crisp facets with soft creases, pale ivory planes and cool slate-blue shadows in the folds, a long gently curved body and a broad tail fin, one small round dark eye with a soft highlight, gentle and kind. It swims in side view, filling the frame, against a plain soft grey-blue painted background with a few faint streaks of rain.
